calculation.expression: mom20 if mean(close > SMA60 across valid universe) >= 0.5, otherwise -mom20
calculation.description: Compute each asset's 20-trading-day return. If at least half of the available tradable benchmark instruments are above their 60-day moving average, retain trend orientation; otherwise reverse the cross-sectional trend orientation as a defensive weak-breadth regime signal. Breadth is computed cross-sectionally at each date using only information through that date's close.

validation.regime_notes: 10-day IC: 2020-2022 -0.012036; 2023-2024 -0.003281; 2025-2026 +0.083358; 2027-2028 -0.010211; 2029 YTD +0.061636. Strong breadth IC +0.0310515 versus weak breadth +0.0009615. The full-sample result is driven partly by 2025-2026 and 2029, so use as a capped/conditional ensemble component.
validation.uncertainty_note: Cross-section is normally 15 assets; results use all available instruments with at least 8 valid names and should be interpreted conservatively.
